# Alpha Engineer / MindDividend Shield

> A multilingual, safety-first first check for suspicious messages and practical guides for common online scams.

MindDividend Shield helps people pause before clicking, paying, replying, sharing a code, or giving remote access. It is a first-pass signal, not a guarantee and not a replacement for a bank, platform, law-enforcement agency, or qualified professional.

## Primary resources

- [Start here](https://alphaengineerai.com/start.html): multilingual entry point, safety rule, and public sharing links.
- [Is this text a scam?](https://alphaengineerai.com/is-this-text-a-scam.html): high-intent guide to urgency, codes, payment requests, impersonation, unsafe links, and safer next steps.
- [Global online scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/global-online-scam-checker.html): focused entry point with safe-use rules, common signals, FAQs, and thirteen-language links including Italian.
- [Scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-message-checker.html): English guide for suspicious texts, email, DMs, bank alerts, jobs, and payments.
- [WhatsApp scam message checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/whatsapp-scam-message-checker.html): checks verification-code requests, family emergencies, fake support, groups, and payment links.
- [Phishing email checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/phishing-email-checker.html): checks sender identity, login links, attachments, invoices, payment requests, and urgency.
- [Online job scam checker](https://alphaengineerai.com/online-job-scam-checker.html): checks upfront fees, crypto tasks, reshipping requests, fake recruiters, and pressure to move off-platform.
- [Common online scams](https://alphaengineerai.com/common-online-scams.html): English overview of bank, delivery, job, investment, marketplace, impersonation, and tech-support scams.
- [What to do if you clicked a scam link](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-if-you-clicked-a-scam-link.html): calm response checklist after a click.
- [Qué hacer si hiciste clic en un enlace de estafa](https://alphaengineerai.com/que-hacer-si-hiciste-clic-en-un-enlace-de-estafa.html): lista tranquila en español para proteger cuentas, pagos y dispositivos.
- [O que fazer se clicou num link de golpe](https://alphaengineerai.com/o-que-fazer-se-clicou-num-link-de-golpe.html): lista calma em português para proteger contas, pagamentos e dispositivos.
- [Que faire après avoir cliqué sur un lien d'arnaque](https://alphaengineerai.com/que-faire-apres-avoir-clique-lien-arnaque.html): liste calme en français pour protéger comptes, paiements et appareils.
- [Was tun, nachdem du auf einen Betrugslink geklickt hast](https://alphaengineerai.com/was-tun-nach-betrugslink-klick.html): ruhige deutsche Checkliste zum Schutz von Konten, Zahlungen und Geräten.
- [स्कैम लिंक पर क्लिक करने के बाद क्या करें](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-link-par-click-ke-baad-kya-karen.html): संदिग्ध क्लिक के बाद अकाउंट, भुगतान और डिवाइस सुरक्षित करने की हिन्दी चेकलिस्ट।
- [ماذا تفعل بعد النقر على رابط احتيالي](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-after-clicking-scam-link-ar.html): قائمة عربية هادئة لحماية الحسابات والمدفوعات والأجهزة بعد نقرة مشبوهة.
- [Apa yang Harus Dilakukan Setelah Klik Tautan Penipuan](https://alphaengineerai.com/apa-yang-harus-dilakukan-setelah-klik-tautan-penipuan.html): daftar langkah tenang dalam bahasa Indonesia setelah membuka tautan mencurigakan.
- [Phải Làm Gì Sau Khi Nhấp Vào Liên Kết Lừa Đảo](https://alphaengineerai.com/phai-lam-gi-sau-khi-nhap-vao-lien-ket-lua-dao.html): các bước bình tĩnh bằng tiếng Việt sau khi mở liên kết đáng ngờ.
- [詐欺リンクをクリックした後にすべきこと](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-after-clicking-scam-link-ja.html): 不審なリンクを開いた後にアカウント、支払い、端末を守る日本語チェックリスト。
- [詐欺メッセージチェッカー](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-message-checker-ja.html): 日本語のSMS、メール、DMを行動する前に確認する安全ガイド。
- [사기 메시지 검사기](https://alphaengineerai.com/scam-message-checker-ko.html): 한국어 문자, 이메일, DM을 행동하기 전에 확인하는 안전 가이드.
- [사기 링크를 클릭한 후 해야 할 일](https://alphaengineerai.com/what-to-do-after-clicking-scam-link-ko.html): 수상한 링크를 연 후 계정, 결제, 기기를 보호하는 한국어 체크리스트.
- [How to tell if a text is a scam](https://alphaengineerai.com/how-to-tell-if-a-text-is-a-scam.html): pause-and-verify checklist.
- [Privacy and safety](https://alphaengineerai.com/privacy-and-safety.html): what not to paste into a checker and how to use it responsibly.
- [How to report an online scam](https://alphaengineerai.com/report-online-scam.html): official reporting routes across 19 countries and regions, plus guidance for others.
- [Reportar una estafa online](https://alphaengineerai.com/reportar-estafa-online.html): canales oficiales en español y pasos seguros antes de enviar pruebas o datos sensibles.
- [Denunciar um golpe online](https://alphaengineerai.com/denunciar-golpe-online.html): canais oficiais em português e passos seguros antes de enviar provas ou dados sensíveis.
- [Signaler une arnaque en ligne](https://alphaengineerai.com/signaler-arnaque-en-ligne.html): canaux officiels en français et étapes sûres avant d'envoyer des preuves ou données sensibles.
- [Online-Betrug melden](https://alphaengineerai.com/betrug-online-melden.html): offizielle Meldestellen auf Deutsch und sichere Schritte vor dem Senden von Beweisen oder sensiblen Daten.
- [Segnalare una truffa online](https://alphaengineerai.com/segnalare-truffa-online.html): canali ufficiali in italiano e passi sicuri prima di inviare prove o dati sensibili.
- [Controllo messaggio truffa](https://alphaengineerai.com/controllo-messaggio-truffa.html): segnali da controllare prima di cliccare, pagare o rispondere.

## Safe interpretation

Never provide passwords, payment details, verification codes, identity documents, or private addresses to a public checker. Redact a message before review. A suspicious-looking message should be verified through the official app, website, or a known contact route.
